summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing completion of Part A treatment in a Phase I/II trial for CMND-100 targeting Alcohol Use Disorder. The filing is a routine regulatory update on clinical trial progress, not a special situation. No deal terms, price, or strategic corporate event is involved. The announcement describes 24 participants across 4 cohorts completing the protocol with data review underway. As a foreign private issuer report under SEC Rule 13a-16, this is a standard operational milestone, not an event triggering any M&A, activist, or restructuring classification. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
